observations.why: The verb 'adopting' frames the move to a new system as embracing novelty — an openness-to-change value appeal, not merely a factual report.
The quantified performance claim appeals to mastery and capability (competence) and competitive advantage (self-enhancement) as the goods justifying the adoption.
Deferring the migration to a named future cycle tempers the novelty with a stabilizing cadence — conservation of current operations before the change.
The summary label frames the decision around the tool's analytical capability, appealing to competence as the organizing value.
The distilled performance metric reiterates the competence and competitive-edge value appeal in summary form.
Anchoring the start to a specific quarter enacts a controlled, scheduled transition — conservation value of orderly stability over abrupt change.
